title: Let's see my Mods
description: What are my Mods, whit this you can inspect your Mods!
body:
See In-game what Mods you have installed with **/mods**

This Mod only should be used for Client-Side and with **/mods** you can see your installed mods, it has a bug which shows some API's from mods, i'm working on a fix soon!

**In the next update, I will include a feature that allows you to update your mods in-game.**

# I don't know why i created this Mod :)
